parts.t: Dunbar is one of Vancouver's most consistently desirable West Side neighbourhoods — a place where tree-lined streets, exceptional schools, and a tight-knit community combine to create an ideal family environment. Its local village atmosphere and proximity to the University of British Columbia add to its enduring appeal.
